title: Blue theme, contact details, tagline, global funds USP, and professional imagery

requirements.text: Update the site-wide color theme from forest-green/gold to a professional blue palette. Replace all green-based primary colors in index.css, tailwind.config.js, and all components with deep navy/royal blue as the primary color and gold/amber as accent. Ensure buttons, gradients, section backgrounds, card borders, and badge colors all use the new blue palette consistently across Navigation, HeroSection, AdvisorProfile, FundCategoriesSection, WhyInvestSection, LeadForm, Footer, and DashboardPage.

quotes: Website should be in Blue Color

acceptanceCriteria: Primary color tokens in index.css and tailwind.config.js are updated to deep navy/royal blue shades
All green-colored UI elements (buttons, headers, badges, borders, backgrounds) are replaced with blue equivalents
Gold/amber accent colors are retained for contrast and highlights
No residual forest-green colors remain in the visible UI

requirements.text: Add a dedicated 'Unique Investment Strategy: Global Funds Beyond India' section on the HomePage. This section should highlight the tagline 'Plan-Invest-Grow', explain Darshit Sheth's unique approach of offering international/global mutual fund options beyond Indian markets, and present 2–3 key differentiators (e.g., global diversification, access to international growth, USD-denominated assets). Style it as a premium full-width banner or feature section that visually stands out from the rest of the page.

quotes: Add Unique investment Strategy: Global funds beyond India. Tag line -Plan-Invest-grow.

acceptanceCriteria: A distinct 'Unique Investment Strategy' section appears on the HomePage
The tagline 'Plan-Invest-Grow' is prominently displayed within this section
The section communicates the benefit of global/international fund access beyond India
Section uses the blue theme with premium styling

requirements.text: Update the email address to shethdarshit@live.com and location to 'Vadodara, Gujarat, India' in all components where contact details appear — including Footer, AdvisorProfile, LeadForm (placeholder or pre-filled city hint), and any other component displaying email or location.

quotes: Email Id should be shethdarshit@live.com and Location should be - Vadodara,Gujarat,India.

acceptanceCriteria: Footer displays shethdarshit@live.com as the contact email
Footer displays 'Vadodara, Gujarat, India' as the location
AdvisorProfile shows updated email and location if applicable
No old/placeholder email or location values remain visible anywhere on the site

requirements.text: Replace the HeroSection background with a generated professional image showing a financial advisor and investors in professional business attire. Also add a professional advisor portrait image in the AdvisorProfile section. Both images should use the blue color tone consistent with the site theme. Render these as static assets from frontend/public/assets/generated.

quotes: Investors and Financial advisor Image with Professional Dressing

acceptanceCriteria: HeroSection background displays a professional image of a financial advisor and investors in business attire
AdvisorProfile section includes a professional advisor portrait
Images are loaded from frontend/public/assets/generated
Images use blue-toned professional color grading consistent with the site theme

requirements.text: Display the tagline 'Plan-Invest-Grow' prominently in the Navigation logo area (alongside the Planinvestgrow brand name), in the HeroSection, and in the Footer. Ensure it is styled as a distinct tagline (smaller than the brand name, possibly in gold/amber accent color).
acceptanceCriteria: Tagline 'Plan-Invest-Grow' appears in the Navigation near the logo/brand name
Tagline appears in the HeroSection
Tagline appears in the Footer
Tagline is visually distinct from the brand name, styled with accent color

constraints: Do not modify any files under frontend/src/hooks/ or frontend/src/components/ui
Backend schema and data model must not change
Planinvestgrow brand name must be retained; only adding the tagline alongside it
nonGoals: Changes to the admin dashboard data model or backend logic
Adding new fund categories beyond what already exists

required: Wide-format professional scene with a financial advisor and two investors seated at a desk in a modern office, all in formal business attire, blue-toned lighting with soft gold highlights, suitable as a full-width hero background (hero-professional.dim_1920x1080.png)
Professional headshot-style portrait of a male financial advisor in a dark navy business suit against a soft blue gradient background, confident expression (advisor-portrait.dim_600x600.png)
